item.description:
Etna 1.0 (build 2)

First public build with auto-updates.

  • Records your meetings — mic and system audio — and transcribes them on this Mac. Audio never leaves the device.
  • Recognizes speakers across meetings and labels the transcript with names.
  • Detects Zoom, Teams, Slack, FaceTime, Webex, Discord, and browser calls automatically.
  • Lives behind the notch: a live meeting surface with transcript, input level, and controls.
  • Files finished notes into your Obsidian vault and keeps it organized.
  • Keeps itself up to date: Etna checks for updates once a day. You can turn this off in Settings → General.
